model_requirements.model_types: Deep learning architectures and pre-trained models

execution_workflow: Load and preprocess 3 distinct NER datasets.
Initialize 5 different deep learning models for token classification.
Fine-tune each of the 5 models on all 3 datasets independently.
Evaluate all model-dataset combinations to extract Accuracy and F1 scores.
Compile the evaluation metrics into a standardized comparative table.

code_submission.required_structure: Clean, well-organized code utilizing classes and separate files. Must include documentation.
forbidden_items: Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb) with uncompleted code or arbitrary executions

changelog: 2024-05-18: Migrated to HuggingFace 'evaluate' library instead of standalone 'seqeval' due to installation issues on Python 3.12.
2024-05-18: Replaced seqeval and evaluate with scikit-learn for metrics due to strict setuptools errors with seqeval in Python 3.12.
2024-05-18: Switched datasets source to Kaggle. Added python-dotenv for API key management and updated requirements.
